scope: Close the recurrent training-layout integration gap on all remaining discrete simulator scenarios.55short gates only; no new learning jobs or performance claim.
release_requirements: Every declared run completes at10k with finite losses,correct rollout/optimizer/seed counts and matching frozen source/config.
Every run evaluates four complete episodes at each endpoint and exactly replays its four final episodes from the checkpoint.
Compare each scenario shape against its prior native integration; check resolved capabilities,simulator versions,return reductions and final-score win semantics.
All five methods in a scenario must pass together; retain failures and incomplete conditions.
Review per-task Slurm RSS/runtime before a separate learning pilot; no full-budget learning is authorized by a native score.

resource_evidence.football: Prior50-engine 3v1 native workers peak3652120KiB=3.48GiB;8GiB was more than twice that.10-agent corner networks may use more;8GiB/45min is a diagnostic cap,not a measured requirement.
resource_evidence.smac: Prior25-engine terran5 native peak22274936KiB=21.24GiB;1M peak22GiB.32GiB/60min per new scenario is a diagnostic cap;larger agent/observation shapes must be measured.

scheduling.football: One8GiB worker waits for all local-scale gates21280689,thus reusing their two4GiB slots after the entire HC3confirmation/replay chain. Future local-scale1M learning must wait for this Football gate array or another verified free capacity chain.
scheduling.smac: At most two32GiB workers wait for the entire current SMAC10M array21272799,reusing its allocation. No existing job modified.

limitations: Canonical SMAC capability settings are incompletely specified by the papers; current pinned reconstruction remains explicit.
Football5v5 native complete-match returns cannot be declared equivalent to the historical figure because its exact evaluation reduction remains unresolved.
Current recurrent actors use one-decision training chunks and a feedforward shared critic; other release architecture differences are unchanged.
All controls use development seed0. Integration results have no across-training-seed uncertainty or paper-budget performance meaning.
